messages.text: what would you call software that I can reshape to my needs by talking to an agent, with the changes showing up live? A friend of mine calls it clay software.

I'd call it **Shape-Shifting Software**.

The idea is software you keep reshaping in plain language, with an agent rewriting the application underneath and each change showing up as you talk.

A few terms worth telling apart:

| Term | Emphasis |
|---|---|
| Clay Software | Software that keeps taking the shape of your needs |
| Pliable Software | Software users can bend themselves |
| Agentic Software | Software driven by autonomous agents |
| Generative UI | Interfaces drawn on the fly by a model |
| Live Software | Changes land at once, with no redeploy |
| Personal Software | Software made for one person rather than a market |

Your friend's phrase fits a longer tradition: research groups have been writing about **“pliable software”** for years, a term with a whole body of essays behind it at small independent labs. [Loomwell +1](cite:loomwell)

My preference:

- **Clay Software** — the most memorable, easy to say out loud.
- **Shape-Shifting Software** — the best technical description.
- **Self-Rewriting Software** — the most literal, but it sounds a little alarming.

The key distinction: **you don't just configure the software; you change what the software is.**
Is a 12-month deposit at 4.1% better than a high-yield account at 3.8%?

Over a year the fixed deposit earns a little more **if rates fall**, and a little less if they rise.

| | 12-month deposit | High-yield account |
|---|---|---|
| Rate | 4.1%, fixed | 3.8%, variable |
| On $10,000 | $410 | about $380 |
| Access | Locked, with a penalty | Any time |

If you might need the money before next autumn, keep it in the account.
Rent or buy a two-bedroom in Lisbon if I stay five years?

Five years is about the break-even point once you count the **purchase tax**, notary fees and the agent's cut on resale.

- **Buy** if you are fairly sure you stay longer than five years.
- **Rent** if a move abroad is a real possibility.
Give me a weekend sourdough schedule that works with a 9am start.

1. **Friday 22:00** — feed the starter.
2. **Saturday 9:00** — mix, then autolyse for an hour.
3. **10:00 to 13:00** — four sets of stretch and folds.
4. **18:00** — shape and put it in the fridge.
5. **Sunday 9:00** — bake at 250 °C, lid on for 20 minutes.
Four days, leaving from the city, autumn colours. Ideas?

Three loops that fit four days:

- **The lakes** — short drives, cabins by the water.
- **The vineyard valley** — harvest season, slow roads.
- **The coast road** — fewer colours, better sunsets.
Two-bay or four-bay NAS for photo backups?
Go **four-bay**: you start with two drives mirrored and grow without moving everything.
How do I put the smart plugs on their own network?
Make a VLAN for them, give it its own SSID, and only allow it to reach the **home server**, not the rest of the LAN.
My passport expires in seven months. Renew now?
Yes. Many countries want **six months of validity** on arrival, so renew before you book anything.
A hangboard plan for twice a week?
Keep it short: **7 seconds on, 3 off**, six reps, three sets, and stop well before your fingers feel it.

c-icons.title: I see ? instead of proper icons for some tabs

messages.text: I see ? instead of proper icons for some tabs.
That glyph is the font's fallback. The tab names an icon the bundle does not ship: check the name against `IconName`.
thread 'tokio-rt-worker' (88213) panicked at src/net.rs:42

Line 42 unwraps a socket read. Return the error instead:

```rust
let read = socket.read(&mut buffer).await?;
```

c-restart.title: I restarted and it did not bring my tabs back

messages.text: I restarted and it did not bring my tabs back.
Tabs are saved when they change. If the app was killed before the first save, there was nothing to restore yet.

c-plus.title: When using the + to add a new terminal

messages.text: When using the + to add a new terminal, it opens in my home folder.
The new tab takes the kind's default `cwd`. Pass the current tab's folder as a prop instead.

c-flicker.title: When an agent finishes, the sidebar flickers

messages.text: When an agent finishes, the sidebar flickers.
The list is rebuilt without keys. Give each row a `key` so it stays itself.
Starship shows boxes.
Install **Symbols Nerd Font Mono**; it is the default fallback.
Zoom resets on reload.
Keep the zoom in the mod's state; state outlives reloads.

c-init.title: In ledger/src/main.rs I initialize the logger twice

messages.text: In ledger/src/main.rs I initialize the logger twice.
Call `init` once in `main` and pass nothing down; the second call returns an error you can drop.
Did you mean to send something?
Still here.
Take your time.

c-mobile.title: On mobile, the reading width is too narrow

messages.text: On mobile, the reading width is too narrow.
Drop the side margins under 600 px and let the column take the full width.
Five questions for a weekly review?

1. What went well?
2. What drained me?
3. What did I avoid?
4. Who helped?
5. What is the one thing next week?
Equity or salary?
Count the equity at **zero** first. If the salary alone works, the equity is upside.
Why are my tomatoes splitting?
Uneven watering: a dry spell, then a lot at once. Water deeply and regularly.

c-spending.title: Review your spending spike and what caused it

messages.text: Why did spending jump in September?
Two annual renewals and the flights landed in the same month. Without them, September is in line with the summer.
Tired every afternoon since I added a fourth run.
Make one of the four runs **easy**, and check sleep before adding volume again.
